findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: find_alternatives, search_workflow_recipes, get_usage_questions, choose_stack, list_stack_jobs · Private data: search_recipes, get_recipe, find_alternatives, get_build_packet, search_workflow_recipes, get_workflow_recipe, leaderboard, audit_stack, get_detection_rules, get_usage_questions, start_audit, list_categories, get_my_plan, choose_stack, plan_stack_from_spec, list_stack_jobs, report_outcome · Public sink: search_recipes, get_recipe, find_alternatives, get_build_packet, search_workflow_recipes, get_workflow_recipe, leaderboard, audit_stack, get_detection_rules, get_usage_questions, start_audit, list_categories, get_my_plan, choose_stack, plan_stack_from_spec, list_stack_jobs, report_outcome · Destructive: get_recipe.
